description: This source file fetches prompt data from remote URLs (in Chinese and English), processes the data, and saves it locally as a JSON file.

methods.name: timeoutPromise
methods.description: Creates a promise that rejects after a specified timeout period.

methods.name: fetchCN
methods.description: Fetches and processes Chinese prompts from a remote URL, filtering out prompts containing ignore words.

methods.name: fetchEN
methods.description: Fetches and processes English prompts from a remote URL, parsing CSV text.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinates fetching both prompt sets and writes the combined data to a local JSON file.
